thread:
maria_sales: Quick sync — onboarding new POC for GreenLayer. They need hosted API keys + a billing project with a hard spend cap of $2,000 for the trial, and a short Dedicated pool eval (2 weeks) if perf looks good. Also asked about VPC option later. Can we provision the project and ephemeral keys today?

peter_se: Do they need Dedicated immediately or can we start with Hosted + ephemeral keys? Dedicated adds procurement lead time.

maria_sales: Prefer Hosted first. Dedicated only if latency tests pass. Key requirements: ephemeral keys scoped to the POC project, spend cap applied, and token quota bump for eval (lots of embeddings).

lina_finops: We can create a billing project and attach a spend cap. For Hosted ephemeral keys we typically:
1) create a trial project (project_id: gl-poc-2026)
2) seed trial credits $2,000
3) attach a spend cap policy so billing stops when reached

Sample API to create project + cap:
```bash
POST /api/internal/v1/projects 
{ "name": "gl-poc-2026", "trial_credits": 2000, "spend_cap": 2000, "owner": "maria_sales" }
```
(ops will run this, then we issue ephemeral API keys scoped to the project)

ops-bot: Ticket created: #6543 — "GreenLayer POC billing project + ephemeral keys" (<https://redwood.internal/tickets/6543>) :ticket:

amy_se: Quick checklist for next phases (VPC/Dedicated):
- IP allowlist / peering details from customer
- Estimated concurrent tokens/sec to size Dedicated pool
- Security questionnaire (we'll need answers for KMS, data residency, access controls)

peter_se: Token quota defaults are low for embeddings. Recommend bumping to 1M tokens/day for the POC or set a per-minute token rate. Example config we use for POC embeddings:
```json
{ "project": "gl-poc-2026", "quotas": { "daily_tokens": 1000000, "tokens_per_minute": 20000 } }
```
I can submit the quota increase after project creation.

maria_sales: Can the ephemeral keys be rotated and scoped so they expire at end of trial automatically? We want no manual cleanup.

lina_finops: Yes — we issue ephemeral keys with TTL. We'll set TTL = 14 days to match the 2-week trial. Spend cap will still enforce charge cutoff. ETA: Hosted project + ephemeral keys + spend cap — 24-48 business hours. Dedicated pool request needs capacity approval, ~3 business days if GPUs available.

peter_se: I'll kick off the Dedicated pool sizing request once I get their concurrency numbers. I'll also pre-fill the security questionnaire for the VPC option (helps speed approval). :thumbsup:

maria_sales: Perfect. Lina, can you confirm whether we require a credit card on file for the project to be created? If not, how do we handle billing contact?

lina_finops: No CC required for trial projects with trial credits — we'll attach internal trial funding and billing contact to the project. For any Dedicated commitment we need a PO or contract.

amy_se: For the security questionnaire, I'll pull the standard POC answers and mark items they need to sign off on (KMS, IP peering). If they want private deployment later, we'll route to Private team.

peter_se: Action items: 1) ops -> create project gl-poc-2026 + spend cap & seed credits (lina) 2) infra -> issue ephemeral keys TTL=14d (ops) 3) se -> collect concurrency numbers and start Dedicated request (peter) 4) answers -> security questionnaire draft (amy).

maria_sales: Thanks — please tag me when the project is provisioned so I can share keys with the customer via secure channel.

lina_finops: Started work on ticket #6543, target to close today for the Hosted pieces. Will update here when done.

ops-bot: #6543 updated: project created draft (awaiting final approval).
